name: Wild Dads
overview: In a rare visual masterpiece, "Fatherhood in the Animal Kingdom" offers a humanistic and scientific documentation of parental relationships in the animal kingdom. From penguins incubating their eggs under the snow to lions fiercely protecting their cubs, the film reveals the meanings of sacrifice, protection, and warmth in astonishing, instinctive situations. It is a work that combines science and emotion at their finest.
